summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is reportedly calling President Trump daily to urge renewed military action against Iran, though he is not currently pushing for immediate strikes. An Iran-linked hacker group distributed threatening flyers in Tel Aviv warning of attacks on Israeli energy infrastructure if leaders strike the 'resistance front.' Iraq has reopened the Al-Shaib border crossing with Iran despite U.S. pressure to keep crossings closed.
key_points: Netanyahu calls Trump daily urging war against Iran but not currently pushing for strikes (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9812)

Iraq reopens Al-Shaib border crossing with Iran days after U.S. requested closures and announced Task Force Iron Gate (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9817)
Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Turkey urge Trump to avoid Iran strikes, prefer diplomacy (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9811)
Iranian drones Hormuz 450 and 900 operate over Beirut and southern Lebanon since morning (Source: @redlinkleb/52409)
Explosion reported near Radar Tabriz in Iran's East Azerbaijan province, cause unknown (Source: @shin_persian/12211)
Israel and Morocco deepen security ties with procurement deals, joint training, and defense industry cooperation (Source: @yediotnews25/137578)
Lebanese army schedules controlled detonation of war remnants in Barish town (Source: @redlinkleb/52444)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is reportedly calling President Trump daily to urge renewed military action against Iran, though he is not currently pushing for immediate strikes. An Iran-linked hacker group distributed threatening flyers in Tel Aviv warning of attacks on Israeli energy infrastructure if leaders strike the 'resistance front.' Iraq has reopened the Al-Shaib border crossing with Iran despite U.S. pressure to keep crossings closed.

points: A fire was reported near the Kharrazi highway in Iran at 07:35 local time (0305Z), according to a delayed incident feed from the FromIran monitoring system with a 120-second delay, showing the location as near the Kharrazi highway in Iran (Source: @shin_persian/12209).

An explosion occurred near the Radar Tabriz area in East Azerbaijan Province, Iran, with the reason unclear, reported via the FromIran delayed incident feed at 07:35 local time (Source: @shin_persian/12211).
Jet activity was detected over Urmia in West Azerbaijan Province, Iran, at 07:19 local time (0349Z), according to a delayed post via FromIran with a 120-second delay (Source: @shin_persian/12208).
Iran's top security official told the United States to stop manufacturing fake news about imaginary talks, per a Reuters report citing the official's statement (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9814).

Satellite imagery from 08/11/2026 shows a burn mark on the Omani island of Didamar at coordinates 26°28'38.38"N 56°32'18.93"E, precisely where the island's radar and radio communication infrastructure is located; the IRGC claims these systems were used by the U.S. Navy to facilitate escorted vessel passage through the Omani route (Source: @shin_persian/12198).

President Trump referenced 'two victories, Venezuela and Iran' while defending Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth against impeachment efforts, stating recruitment is at an all-time high (Source: @shin_persian/12207).
An Israeli HRON aircraft (sequence 738BE8, squawk 3103) was tracked at 29,800 ft over Palestine, identified as a Booster call sign (Source: @redlinkleb/52468).
An Israeli TEX2 aircraft (sequence 738A5F, squawk 4006) was tracked at 11,850 ft over Palestine, registration 490 (Source: @redlinkleb/52412).
Israeli fighter jets were reported heading south toward the Lebanon border area, per a live map alert (Source: @redlinkleb/52446).

An Israeli GLF5 Nachshon Eitam SIGINT platform (sequence 738A4D, squawk 1501, registration 569, call sign ROEM) conducted electronic reconnaissance at 39,000 ft over Palestine (Source: @redlinkleb/52467).

Israel Police and Shin Bet are investigating flyers found in northern Tel Aviv mailboxes linked to Iran's Handala Team hacker group; the QR code led to a webpage titled 'warning from handala team' threatening that if Israeli leaders attack energy infrastructure of the resistance front, no power station, oil refinery, or water desalination facility will remain from south to north (Source: @manniefabian/59491).

Netanyahu reportedly calls Trump daily urging resumption of war against Iran but is not currently pushing Trump to launch strikes, per a diplomat briefed on discussions and a person familiar with the situation in Israel (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9812).

Israel and Morocco deepened security cooperation: Director General of the Defense Ministry Amir Baram met with Morocco's defense minister and chief of staff, discussing procurement deals, joint training, Israeli defense industry assistance in establishing an independent Moroccan defense industry, and inaugurated the permanent Israeli defense attaché office in Rabat (Source: @yediotnews25/137578).

No specific operational messages regarding Gaza or West Bank military activity were present in the current dataset; Israeli aircraft tracking messages list location as Palestine but do not specify ground operations in Gaza or West Bank (Source: @redlinkleb/52468, @redlinkleb/52412, @redlinkleb/52467).
The Lebanese army will conduct a controlled detonation of war remnants in the town of Barish between 12:00 and 14:00 local time (Source: @redlinkleb/52444).
Red Alert Lebanon issued a signal scan warning for the south region, urging caution, with a live map display (Source: @redlinkleb/52415).
An Iranian drone identified as Hormuz 450 entered the southern suburbs and Beirut airspace, while Hormuz 900 continued flying since 07:00 local time (Source: @redlinkleb/52409).
Israeli fighter jets were observed heading south toward Lebanon, per a live map alert (Source: @redlinkleb/52446).
Red Alert Lebanon pinned a message showing a live map with a signal scan alert for the south region (Source: @redlinkleb/52414).

Iraqi Prime Minister al-Zaidi is awaiting authorization from Iraq's ruling coalition to arrest members of Iran-aligned armed factions in the country; the coalition has warned him this could cause governmental collapse (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9818).

Iraq reopened the Al-Shaib border crossing with Iran days after the U.S. requested the closure of Iraqi border crossings and Trump announced the creation of Task Force Iron Gate to monitor them (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9817).
No specific Syria-related operational messages were present in the current dataset.

Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, and Turkey are pressing Trump not to resume strikes on Iran, with their leaders personally urging diplomacy over military escalation, per the Financial Times (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9811).

Trump told Reuters that Qatar and Saudi Arabia would prefer a peaceful resolution to the conflict with Iran, but said the United States remains prepared to carry out strikes if necessary, following talks with Qatar's leader (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9807).

Satellite imagery reveals a burn mark on Oman's Didamar island at radar and radio communication infrastructure coordinates 26°28'38.38"N 56°32'18.93"E on 08/11/2026; the IRGC claims these systems were used by the U.S. Navy to facilitate escorted vessel passage through the Omani route (Source: @shin_persian/12198).
